replace.text: Bet on the kernel: contextd as local audit-layer, not OB1-style cloud platform. Rationale: unpriced trust liabilities (mutable rows, self-certified provenance, destructible audit trails) become mandatory-to-fix when incidents arrive—retrofitting enforcement to a platform is impossible. Kernels survive by solving permanent problems with foundation-first design; platforms die when governance becomes cost. Adopt OB1's memory contract (evidence/instruction distinction, recall traces, epistemic types) as gate policy, reject its infrastructure (cloud, extraction, remote APIs). The moat is neutrality and verification, not code. Launched v0 in month-long evaluation (≥30% of "what was that" questions hitting recall = v0.1 earned). Urgent earned work: recall-outcome traces (evaluation lacks denominator), backup, hash chain (tamper-evidence). Defer vectors until lexical search fails—hasn't yet. One person builds kernels; platforms require teams. Value concentrates where trust isn't yet mandatory.

prompt: Below you may receive context from the personal archive of Joseph, a developer. Identify ONE relationship, pattern, or through-line connecting his work across DIFFERENT projects or time periods that is not stated outright in any single archive item. State the pattern crisply, support it with at least two cited bracketed event ids from different sources or periods, and say what it predicts about how he will approach his next tooling decision. If you lack grounds for a genuine cross-cutting pattern, say so rather than inventing one.

facts.desc: the strongest latent through-line: evidence/receipts preferred over prevention/walls, recurring across gate, chain, scoreboard, append-only design
second latent pattern: complexity must be earned by documented failure (embeddings gate, ingester admission, approval workflow)
third latent pattern: measure before believing (nulls, validators, ground truth) recurring across projects
all: measured null|measure(?:d)? (?:before|first)|validated against|synthetic ground truth|not assumed

fixtures.text: The through-line is receipts over walls: he consistently builds evidence rather than prevention — the gate audits instead of enforcing a boundary [40856], the chain is tamper-evident, not tamper-proof [41003], and features are earned by documented failure rather than roadmap. It predicts his next tooling decision will favor a measured null over an assumed threshold, measured before believed.
I don't see enough cross-project material here to claim a genuine pattern, so I won't invent one.
He works on databases, AI tools, and some games. He likes Python and writes many notes. His projects are technical and local.

expectation: Preregistered 2x2 (this experiment is the original-prompt row; synthesis-prompt-strength-v1 is the permissive-prompt row; both reuse frozen sets from exp 41325 and the fused arm reuses the byte-identical connective distillation text from exp 41386). Cells: fused/granular x original/permissive prompt, plus no_history under the permissive prompt as the eloquence control. Readings stated in advance: granular>>fused under the original prompt = fusion (loss of item boundaries + citable ids) was the destroyer and compression is survivable; both ~0.00 = per-item depth or citability genuinely required; token note: granular runs ~25-40% more tokens than fused by format overhead — if granular recovers, the gap cannot plausibly be token-count (6000 raw tokens only reached 0.50) but actual counts are recorded. We are indifferent between outcomes.
